rationale: Price has held below session VWAP ($8.87) since the open, printing lower highs and lower lows, and just broke to a fresh session low on the heaviest 1-minute volume of the sample (43.9k vs 2–16k prior) — evidence of continued distribution rather than seller absorption, with the risk-off tape (SPY -0.77%, VIXY +2.66%) as a tailwind. Location is late (7.3% of range, ~4.5% below VWAP), so I am sizing small, invalidating above the $8.55–$8.62 consolidation shelf at $8.68 (~2.3% risk, ~$135 on this size against the remaining loss budget), and using a 3% trailing profit to let continuation develop while capping damage from a violent low-of-day bounce.
